quest.title: Easybreeze Holiday Resort
quest.description: Head to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort and enjoy a colorful summer

dialogues.speaker: Miztli
dialogues.text: Please embark from here! We'll set sail soon!

dialogues.speaker: Miztli
dialogues.text: Take your time! Just let me know when you're ready.

talks.objective: Go to the resort's check-in desk

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Hello, and welcome to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort! I'll get you all checked into your accommodations.

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Please take this map, along with a special commemorative photo album we've prepared for our guests.

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: The resort is made up of four main areas: Colorfall Cliffs, Guiztli Ridge, Wavey Bay, and Tete Isle. Feel free to explore them at your leisure!

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Well, your accommodations are in that direction. Feel free to head there if you need some rest. And, if you're looking to do some shopping, the Easybreeze Market — our busiest attraction — is right over here.

dialogues.speaker: Miztli
dialogues.text: Dear visitors, welcome to Dreambow Drift! Kick back, relax, and take in the stunning views of the canyon from our hot air balloon.

dialogues.speaker: Miztli
dialogues.text: Whenever you're ready, just let me know, and we'll have you aboard in no time!
